# Web.de Access

Read, organize, draft, and send mail from your WEB.DE account.

| Maintenance | Maintained |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.2.15 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/Web.de-Access) |

Personally used and maintained as needed, without a release schedule or support guarantee.

## Example request

> Find unread WEB.DE messages from today and draft a reply to the latest one.

## Requirements

Requires Node.js and an operating-system credential store supported by keytar. Windows is the release-test platform; other platforms may need native dependencies.

- A WEB.DE account with IMAP access enabled
- An application password when required by your account
- Node.js 20.19 or newer and Git

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add webde-access@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install webde-access@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Enable IMAP in WEB.DE. Store credentials through the plugin's auth:login helper, following the source README.
- Credentials belong in the operating-system credential manager, never in marketplace files or chat. Install dependencies in the plugin directory if the first-start helper requests them.
- Ask the plugin to read or draft a message. Sending mail is a separate action that you explicitly request.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\webde-access
/reload
```
